name: Feature request

title: "[feature] "

---

## Problem

What problem does this solve? What is the user pain today?

## Proposed solution

What should change? Describe the user-visible behavior and any new IPC /
storage shape you have in mind.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you weighed, and why this one is better.

## Scope

- Is this a single-PR change, or does it imply follow-up work?
- Does it require new permissions, new dependencies, or changes to the
  crash-recovery / proxy-restore path?
- Does it need UI work on multiple pages, or just one?

## Additional context

Screenshots, mockups, links to related issues / discussions.
